newsitem.title: CHINA: Foreign banks' loan balances up in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Foreign banks' loan balances up in Shanghai.

text.p: Foreign banks' foreign currency loan balance has topped that of Chinese banks for the first time in Shanghai, reaching $8.17 billion at the end of October, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The newspaper said foreign banks' loan balance was $2.16 billion higher than 1995.
It said the combined assets of foreign banks in Shanghai at the end of October was $13.38 billion, up $4.35 billion over the end of 1995.

Separately, it said the two foreign insurance companies operating in Shanghai, American International Assurance and Japan's Tokio Marine, took in premiums of more than 400 million yuan in the first 10 months of this year.
